name: Real estate video app prices from the tools' own pages
description: Published prices of 27 apps and tools that make listing videos (from photos, from a phone recording, AI agent videos and general editors), read from each tool's own pricing page or US App Store listing on 18 November 2026: price for one video, cheapest monthly plan billed monthly and yearly, what is free, output, voiceover and music, platforms, the source URL and notes on comparability.
creator: October (october-ai.com)

changelog.change: First release: 27 tools, each read from its own pricing page or App Store listing on 18 November 2026; median cheapest monthly plan of 9 real estate video tools $33.

fields.description: The app or tool, as it names itself.
